# Contributing

This repository is a copy of the released `onlinecompiler` Python package (PyPI), updated at each release.

- **Bugs and requests:** open an issue here. We read every one.
- **Pull requests:** welcome. We apply accepted changes upstream, and they arrive here with the next release, so your pull request will be closed with a link to that release rather than merged.
- **Questions about the API itself** (limits, languages, your account): https://onlinecompiler.io/contact?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=onlinecompiler-python
